subject: Anna Callahan City Council Candidacy
overview: Councilor Anna Callahan presented her platform for re-election, focusing on her first-term legislative record and her model for community-driven policy development.

items.title: Legislative Record
items.summary: Councilor Anna Callahan summarized her first-term achievements, including rodent control ordinances, school and road funding, and affordable housing efforts.

items.title: Volunteer Engagement Model
items.summary: The candidate described her unique structure of five volunteer teams that facilitate community listening sessions and research city council agenda items.

items.title: Resident-Led Policy and Outreach
items.summary: Callahan invited residents to submit ideas for city projects, highlighting active initiatives for tree planting and senior housing options.
